question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party, state institutions, and military underpins the 95.3% trader consensus that he will not be removed from power before 2027. Constitutional changes ending presidential term limits, combined with the absence of a designated successor and his active role in 2026 diplomacy and the 15th Five-Year Plan launch, reinforce expectations of continuity through the next Party Congress. Recent analyses highlight preparations for a potential fourth term rather than any transition, with no verified challenges, health events, or elite fractures emerging in the past year. While the market implies low probability of abrupt removal, plausible shifts could still arise from sudden medical issues, major policy setbacks prompting internal pressure, or unforeseen leadership crises before year-end.
